description: Delete a branch outright. If a human may want the rule back, PATCH `enabled: false` instead — a disabled branch stays visible with its reasoning, a deleted one does not. Note the mirror rule: a step a branch JUMPS TO cannot be deleted while the branch exists (409), because that would leave the branch pointing at nothing.
